source.publication: 2025 Form 80-100 Resident, Non-Resident and Part-Year Resident Individual Income Tax Instructions (Rev. 12/25) and the 2025 Form 80-105 Resident Return (Rev. 09/25)
source.section: Form 80-105 page 1 lines 8-17 and page 2 lines 38-66; Instructions PDF p.5 Filing Status and Exemptions table; p.6 Additional Exemptions, Lines 8-12; p.7 Lines 14-17; p.22 Tax Rates; p.27 Schedule of Tax Computation lines 1-4; Instructions PDF p.5 Line 3 ('the only deduction you may claim for exemptions is one-half of the amount indicated on line 12') and p.7 Line 15; Form 80-105 line 15 ('if married filing separately use 1/2 amount')

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 40,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income = 40,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 22,650.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 80-105 filing status box 3, Married - Filing Separate Returns. Start at federal AGI 40,000.00 (Mississippi builds its own income on lines 38 to 66; the projection starts from federal AGI and takes out the exempt income, the same result here). Line 66 and line 13 Mississippi AGI = 40,000.00. Line 14 standard deduction 2,300.00. Line 8 age boxes checked 1 (taxpayer and spouse each have a box); line 10 = 1 x 1,500.00 = 1,500.00; line 11 12,000.00; line 12 = 13,500.00; line 15 = one-half of line 12 = 6,750.00 (Line 15, p.7; Line 3, p.5). Line 16 Mississippi taxable income = 40,000.00 - 2,300.00 - 6,750.00 = 30,950.00. Schedule of Tax Computation line 1: first 10,000.00 x 0% = 0.00; line 2: remaining 20,950.00 x 4.4% = 921.80; line 4 and line 17 = 921.80. Lines 18 and 19 credits 0.00; line 20 = 921.80. The form rounds to whole dollars (p.22), which would give 922; expected keeps the formula result. This is the filer's separate return; person 1 is the spouse, under 65. The form halves the whole of line 12, the age exemption included, so the filer gets 750.00 of it, not 1,500.00. The projection holds this as 750 per qualifying person on a married separate return, counting both spouses, which matches the form here and on the mirror return.
accepted_approximations: Mississippi builds its own income (Form 80-105 lines 38 to 66); the projection starts from federal AGI and removes the exempt income through the reliefs and Social Security treatment.
